theme.title: Warriors vs Cavaliers
theme.subtitle: The 2015 and 2017 Finals
theme.recap: Golden State won the first and third of four straight Finals meetings, with both sides setting records along the way.

questions.prompt: Counting the playoffs, how many games did the 2014–15 Warriors win?
questions.context: Golden State Warriors · 2014–15 · regular season plus playoffs

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: Combining regular season and playoff games, Golden State finished 83–20

questions.prompt: Andre Iguodala won 2015 Finals MVP. How many of the 11 votes did he get?
questions.note: Seven. LeBron James got the other four, from the losing team.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: Iguodala received seven out 11 votes; the other four went to James

questions.prompt: In Game 2 of the 2015 Finals, Stephen Curry set a Finals record for missed threes. How many?

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: Curry set an NBA record for most missed three-point attempts in an NBA Finals game with 13.

questions.prompt: Facing a sweep in 2017, Cleveland set a Finals record for points in a quarter. How many?
questions.note: 49 in the first quarter of Game 4.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: Cleveland scored 49 points in the first quarter, the most points of any period in an NBA Finals game

questions.prompt: LeBron James scored 44 points in Game 1 of the 2015 Finals. How many shots did he take?
questions.context: 2015 NBA Finals · Game 1 · at Golden State

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: James had a career NBA Finals high of 44 points, while attempting a postseason career-high 38 shots
